title: TurboWarp SMP
description: General changes only meant for TurboWarp SMP
body:
General changes only meant for TurboWarp SMP

Applies to the following mods:
- Create Diesel Generators

Currently changes these:
- Distillation towers scale with size


(Although it's meant for the SMP I run, this mod can be used by people outside of the SMP, since it has some genuinely great changes)
